queries.sql:
SELECT
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted,
         SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected,
         SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'MODIFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS modified,
         SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired,
         AVG(confidence_score) AS avg_confidence
       FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_AI_AUDIT

SELECT module_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(confidence_score) AS avg_conf
       FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_AI_AUDIT
       WHERE user_action = 'ACCEPTED'
       GROUP BY module_id ORDER BY module_id
